QuestInfo.name: [Temple of Time] Seeking Lost Memories
QuestInfo.0: According to the Memory Keeper, you will need to go back to when the adventure started to recover the Lost Memory. You don't remember exactly when the adventure was but you guess that it was the day you escaped Gelimer's Lab.
QuestInfo.1: According to the Memory Keeper, you will need to go back to when the adventure started to recover the Lost Memory. You don't remember exactly when the adventure was but you guess that it was the day you escaped Gelimer's Lab.
QuestInfo.2: You haven't recovered your memory but you do not regreat the day you left for an adventure.
